scientific_integrity: The extremal set theorem and contextual-abduction definitions are credited to prior work. Standalone finite checks supplement a general proof; no independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact unrestricted obstruction rank for finite classical Horn-abduction explanations with integrity constraints and all hypothesis subsets; clause count/width and computational complexity are not bounded. Acyclic sharpness construction is explicit. Historical priority for abstract order-convexity Helly theorems is not fully resolved.
title: Sharp Helly bound for contextual Horn-abduction explanations with finitely many hypotheses
